# Main Street IQ

> Main Street IQ is financial IQ for lower middle market companies, with two lines of work. Fractional CFO: fractional and interim CFO leadership that works the decisions alongside you, not from the sideline. Wine Country Intelligence: AI advisory for wineries, built on a quarterly benchmark of Central Coast wineries and what AI search says about each one. Led by founder Scott Hess. Main Street IQ is based on California's Central Coast, works in person across six coastal California counties (Santa Barbara, San Luis Obispo, Ventura, Los Angeles, Orange, and San Diego), and works remotely with lower middle market companies nationwide. It goes deepest in DTC ecommerce and wineries, and also works with health and wellness and elective medicine practices. Every Fractional CFO engagement is built on the proprietary RAID Framework (Redundant, Agile, Intelligent, Data-Driven).

## Start Here

Main Street IQ runs two lines of work: Fractional CFO and Wine Country Intelligence. Buyers usually arrive looking for one of them.

- [Main Street IQ, Homepage](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/): Financial IQ for lower middle market companies, in two lines of work. We build the finance function on the RAID model and run it alongside you, with an intelligence engine underneath that reads your market, your funnel, your customer cohorts, and what AI search says about you. Deepest in DTC ecommerce and wineries; also health and wellness and elective medicine practices. In person across six coastal California counties, remote nationwide. Veteran-owned and operated.
- [Fractional CFO, the hub for the CFO line of work](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/fractional-cfo): Senior finance leadership for lower middle market companies, built on the RAID model with a live intelligence engine underneath, delivered by a named CFO rather than software. Engage when you keep your finance team; Manage when you want Main Street IQ to be it. Interim leadership sits here too. AI search visibility and finance automation are part of how the CFO work runs, not separate services. Start here for anything about CFO, controller, or finance-leadership work.
- [CFO and AI advisory for wineries](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/wineries): Fractional and interim CFO and operations work for Santa Barbara and San Luis Obispo County wineries: club pricing, capital allocation and the cash cycle between harvest and release, with AI as the tool. Start here for CFO work for a winery; the quarterly report, Monitor and Monitor Plus are on [the report page](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/wine-country-intelligence).
- [AI Discoverability](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/discoverability): A short routing page for anyone asking how to get found when buyers ask AI who to buy from. Wineries go to Wine Country Intelligence. For every other business, AI visibility is not a separate service: it is read as part of the Fractional CFO work, next to the numbers it moves. The Website Audit is open to any business that wants a one-time written read.
- [Book an Intro Call](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/intro-call): Thirty minutes, founder-to-founder.

## Core Services

- [How We Work](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/our-services): How the Fractional CFO line runs: what the CFO reads (your numbers, your market and AI search, and the automation underneath), and three places you can be with us: reports and audits, Engage, or Manage.
- [Engage](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/engage): A CFO alongside your team. A fractional CFO on a standing monthly cadence: a monthly strategic-oversight session, a quarterly review with a refreshed roadmap, and decision support between sessions on pricing, hiring, capital, and channel decisions. You keep your finance team and own the books. For wineries, Monitor Plus runs underneath. Scoped on an Intro Call.
- [Manage](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/manage): The productized embedded finance and accounting function for lower middle market companies. One fractional CFO, one named operator, four workstreams, and a CEO dashboard. Bookkeeping with accuracy tracked on every close, monthly close signed by day eight, a 13-week cash forecast kept current on a cadence set for each business, and customer cohort unit economics. Limited to three clients at a time. Scoped on an Intro Call.
- [Interim Finance Leadership](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/interim-finance-leadership): For when a CFO, Finance Director, or Head of Finance has just left or is about to. A time-boxed engagement in the seat that embeds in days, stabilizes the function, and hands it to your next permanent hire.
- [Finance Director Services](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/finance-director-services): FP&A, management reporting, and operational finance leadership for companies that need the function but not the CFO price tag. The Finance Director seat is covered through Engage (you keep your team) or Manage (we run the function); full-time cover while you hire is an interim engagement.
- [The RAID Framework](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/raid-framework): How Main Street IQ builds and runs a finance function: Redundant, Agile, Intelligent, Data-Driven. The operating standard behind every Engage and Manage engagement.

Includes a comparison table (AI CFO vs. fractional CFO vs. CPA vs. BI tool vs. FP&A software).

## Reports and Audits

Written findings, with no CFO in the room. The Website Audit is open to any business; the report and Monitor are for wineries.

- [Website Audit and Audit Pro](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/audit): A fixed-price, written, three-layer audit of a website's SEO, answer-engine optimization (AEO), and AI-search visibility, synthesized into the decisions a founder actually has to make. A diagnosis, not a dashboard to interpret. Open to any business, with industry-specific depth for wineries, wellness clinics, elective medicine practices, and ecommerce brands. Prices are published on the page.
- [The Wine Country Intelligence Report](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/wine-country-intelligence): The flagship of Wine Country Intelligence. A quarterly digital-performance benchmark of the wineries of Santa Barbara and San Luis Obispo counties, scored on seven categories, with an AI-visibility read across six AI assistants. Published by county, with a free Central Coast summary covering both. The free summary, the sample edition, the county edition, Monitor and Monitor Plus are on this page.
- [Monitor and Monitor Plus](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/monitor): The monthly report card for wineries: search and AI visibility, reputation, discoverability, and the metrics tied to your next decision, scored the same way every month. Monitor Plus adds a peer set: four named competitors scored on the same dimensions as you. Built for wineries; prices are on the page.

## Glossary

- [Finance & AI Glossary](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/): Plain-language definitions of the finance and AI-search terms behind an AI CFO.
- [AI Visibility](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/ai-visibility): AI visibility is how often, and how accurately, AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity name your business when someone asks them a question you should be the answer to.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/answer-engine-optimization): Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is the practice of structuring your content so that answer engines, the AI systems and featured-snippet tools that give a single direct answer, pull from your business as the source.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/generative-engine-optimization): Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is optimizing your business's presence so that generative AI models, the large language models behind ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity, represent and recommend you accurately when they generate a response.
- [LLM Citation](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/llm-citation): An LLM citation is when a large language model names or links to your business as a source or recommendation inside the answer it generates for a user.
- [llms.txt](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/llms-txt): llms.txt is a plain-text file placed at the root of a website that gives AI systems a clean, curated summary of what the site is about and which pages matter most, the way robots.txt speaks to search crawlers.
- [Schema Markup (Structured Data)](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/schema-markup): Schema markup is standardized code you add to your web pages that labels your content, this is a business name, this is a price, this is an FAQ, so search engines and AI systems can read it unambiguously.
- [Entity & Knowledge Graph](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/entity-knowledge-graph): An entity is a distinct thing a search or AI system recognizes, a specific business, person, or place, and a knowledge graph is the connected map of facts these systems hold about that entity and how it relates to others.
- [Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/retrieval-augmented-generation): Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a technique where an AI model, before answering, retrieves relevant up-to-date information from an external source and uses it to ground its response, rather than relying only on what it memorized during training.
- [AI CFO](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/ai-cfo): An AI CFO is a fractional Chief Financial Officer whose work is powered by a built-in intelligence engine: an operator who turns your financial data into decisions, delivered by a person, not a software product you log into.
- [Fractional CFO](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/fractional-cfo): A fractional CFO is an experienced Chief Financial Officer who works with a company part-time, providing senior strategic finance leadership without the cost of a full-time executive hire.
- [Contribution Margin](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/contribution-margin): Contribution margin is the revenue left from a sale after subtracting the variable costs of delivering it, the money each sale contributes toward covering fixed costs and, beyond that, profit.
- [Unit Economics](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/unit-economics): Unit economics is the profitability of a single unit of your business, one product sold or one customer served, measured by the direct revenues and costs tied to that unit.
- [CAC:LTV Ratio](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/cac-ltv-ratio): The CAC:LTV ratio compares what it costs to acquire a customer (customer acquisition cost) against how much profit that customer generates over their relationship with you (lifetime value), the core test of whether your growth is efficient.
- [Cash Conversion Cycle](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/cash-conversion-cycle): The cash conversion cycle is the time it takes for a dollar you spend, on inventory or delivering a service, to come back to you as collected cash from a customer.
- [Cohort Analysis](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/glossary/cohort-analysis): Cohort analysis groups customers by when they first bought, then tracks how each group behaves over time, so you can see whether customers are getting more or less valuable, and whether retention is improving or decaying.

## The RAID Framework

Every Engage and Manage engagement is built on four principles:
- **Redundant**: Documented, cross-trained processes with no single points of failure.
- **Agile**: Automation first: build systems before hiring people.
- **Intelligent**: Finance that operates like an owner, not a scorekeeper.
- **Data-Driven**: Every workstream owner carries 3-5 KPIs tied to real business levers.

Close of the Found by the Machine series.

### The RAID Framework Series (8 parts)
- [Why Most Finance Teams Fail to Scale](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/why-finance-teams-fail-to-scale): The pattern of finance breaking at $20M, and the 4 failure modes. Series opener.

- [Build Redundant Finance: No More Single Points of Failure](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/build-redundant-finance): The "Redundant" principle: documentation, cross-training, and system access redundancy.

Real CFO work is different, and here's the test to tell them apart.
- [The CFO Filter: Five Questions Before You Adopt the Next AI Tool](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/blog/cfo-filter-for-ai): Every week a new AI tool lands in the inbox and the vendor list grows. The five questions a CFO runs before any of them get adopted, and why most fail at least one.

## Service Areas

Main Street IQ works in person across six coastal California counties and remotely with clients elsewhere in the United States. Only Santa Barbara and San Luis Obispo counties are on the Central Coast; the others are served from it.

- [All Locations, Locations Hub](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/locations): Fractional and interim CFO services for lower middle market companies on the California coast. Based on the Central Coast, working in person across Santa Barbara, San Luis Obispo, Ventura, Los Angeles, Orange, and San Diego counties, and remotely nationwide.
- [Santa Barbara County](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/fractional-cfo-santa-barbara): Fractional and interim CFO in Santa Barbara County for wineries, DTC ecommerce, health and wellness, and elective medicine. Also covers the AI CFO seat for the county.
- [San Luis Obispo County](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/fractional-cfo-san-luis-obispo): Fractional and interim CFO in San Luis Obispo County for wineries, DTC ecommerce, health and wellness, and elective medicine. Also covers the AI CFO seat for the county.
- [AI Consulting: Santa Barbara & San Luis Obispo Counties](https://www.mainstreetiq.com/ai-consulting): AI consulting as part of the Fractional CFO work, not a separate service. For lower middle market companies in Santa Barbara and San Luis Obispo counties and across coastal California: where AI pays back in the back office (close prep, reconciliations, cash forecast reads, report drafting), what AI search says about you, and working systems put in with guardrails, with a human CFO signing every conclusion.
